title: Diamond-Rind Crowned Pineapple
description: One newly authored whole stylised harvested pineapple appearance: a broad squat-ovoid solid fruit body has genuine raised diamond rind faces sharing all valley edges, not a flat pattern painted on a pear. A solid green crown core supports separate thick pointed folded leaves: a recurving outer whorl and narrower rising inner whorl. All body/crown geometry newly authored, not extracted cabbage leaves, extra garlic cloves or recolored cactus pads. Metres Z up, true whole XY bounds-centred, small fruit-bottom sole at Z0; opaque PBR, no textures or alpha cards. One static crop prop with no display stand, scenery or cut section.
